Merging should treat UNDEF cards as normal cards with undef values

As opposed to treating them as comment cards. Otherwise one defined
header and one undef header leads to two headers in the output merged
file rather than two subheaders.

 "Astro::FITS::Header::NDF - write FITS header to file {FILE}"

Critical fix for numeric cards with no space before the comment starts

Card:

  DUT1    =  -1.83507724076233E-6/ [d] UT1-UTC correction

was being parsed as "-1.83507724076233e-" because the parser
assumed there was always a space to the number.
Release v3.03 to CPAN
Remove trailing whitespace and Starlink prologues

Set VERSION in Astro::FITS::HeaderCollection

The Astro::FITS::HeaderCollection namespace is used for tied
subheaders. It's embedded in Header.pm and did not have its
own version number. This meant that Module::Build failed to
write a version into META.yml despite writing an entry for
the namespace in META.yml. This then confused the CPAN indexer
which got upset when an undef version number did not match
the prior CPAN version number.

Standardise on GPL v3

Previously the README and licence file indicated that GPL was being
used but some of the source code indicated the Perl licence. Clarify
that this code is all to be released under GPL and use version 3.
